aio2.notes: Standard serial string per AIO 2-9800 Rev E is WS,WD,AT,RH,BP,RN,SR,BV,CONFIG,CheckSum. Battery voltage (BV) and compass heading (CV) appear only when toggled on at the sensor, so the field count varies. The Step 3 parser maps fields by count and validates each line with the checksum (decimal sum of all characters from the start of the message through the character before the asterisk). CONFIG and CheckSum are metadata, not logged as data columns.

email.notes: min_interval_s throttles repeat emails per rule so a stuck condition does not flood the inbox. Needs a restart.

quality.notes: dropout_s: no new record. stale_s: newest record older than this. frozen_count: identical value repeated this many records. mission_outage_s: Mission unreachable this long before the daemon emails smtp to_addrs (one email, then one on recovery); 0 disables.

alarms.rules_notes: Rules reload while the daemon runs (checked every 30 s), as do channel_status and alarm_rule_email in daq_local.json; other sections need a restart. category is standing or temporary. A temporary rule sets active_from and active_until (local time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) and never trips outside that window. Descriptions must be unique; alarm_rule_email in daq_local.json maps a description to its recipients, and a rule without an entry emails smtp to_addrs. Optional deadband (rule unit, default 0) and clear_dwell_s (default dwell_s): a tripped rule clears only after the value is deadband inside the limit for clear_dwell_s, so a value at the limit does not trip and clear repeatedly.

legacy_outdoor.notes: LabVIEW-era AIO 2 files on Mission under mission_data_dir/<mission_subdir>/YYYY/. The web layer reads them for times before cutover_local and the rebuilt files from cutover_local on. They hold Wind_Speed_m/s, Wind_Direction_deg, Ambient_Temperature_degC, Relative_Humidity_%, and Barometric_Pressure_mb, with a trailing tab on data rows and about 300 repeated and 300 skipped timestamps per day. About 20 min have no data at the cutover (last LabVIEW weather record 12:06:25, first rebuilt record 12:11:35, then a second hole in the rebuilt file that ends 12:27:10).

web.notes: stale_banner_s: heartbeat age past which the group page shows a red banner. stale_alarm_s: heartbeat age on Mission past which the dashboard machine emails smtp to_addrs that the DAQ computer looks offline; stale_renotify_s repeats it while stale. The watchdog runs only in mission mode (override with MH_DAQ_WATCHDOG=1 or 0). max_download_days caps one weather CSV request.

display_ranges.notes: Group dashboard value-card colors only; these are not alarms and send no email. A value below low shows blue, above high shows red, and a value equal to a limit shows normal. Comparison uses the value as displayed (2 decimals). Living-space zones only: garage, attic, outdoor, HVAC supply, and blower channels are left uncolored.
